heard: A six-sided storm wide enough to swallow two Earth spins on Saturn. NASA's Voyager probes first spotted this geometric jet stream at the planet's North Pole. The structure spans 20,000 miles across, wider than two Earths side by side. Even more incredible, each single side of the hexagon is longer than Earth's entire diameter. Winds blast at 200 miles per hour around a central hurricane as wide as a continent. Over decades, the vortex shifted from deep blue to golden yellow as sunlight reacted with methane. This isn't magic. Scientists recreated the exact shape in simple water tanks using basic physics. It proves nature's laws can carve perfect straight lines across an entire planet.
